source.title: Call for Applicants - WCAT Leader (November 2019)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Competitions Announcements Team (WCAT) Leader**, as Henrik Buus Aagaard has resigned. We would like to thank Henrik for the work he has done leading the team. The WCAT is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for approving and announcing WCA competitions.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:
- Strong leadership skills
- Attention to detail
- Very good knowledge of the WCRP
- Excellent communication skills
<!-- break -->
The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **November 30th, 2019, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:
- Brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- Ambitions as the WCAT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WCAT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.1%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: 招募 WCA 比赛公示组负责人（2019 年 11 月）
translation.content:
Henrik Buus Aagaard 已辞去 **WCA 比赛公示组（WCAT）负责人**职务，WCA 将任命新负责人。感谢 Henrik 在带领团队期间所做的工作。WCAT 是 WCA 的咨询委员会之一，负责审批和公告 WCA 比赛。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 8 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

- 较强的领导能力。
- 注重细节。
- 非常熟悉《WCA 比赛要求政策》（WCRP）。
- 出色的沟通能力。

申请期从即日起至 **2019 年 11 月 30 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
- 担任 WCA 比赛公示组负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WCAT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.1%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 [WCA 议案 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
